summary: Phase U — Verified iteration 20: (a) Leadership Team replaces secondary banner on home, (b) routes/pages.py + routes/site_settings.py + routes/ai.py extraction did not break anything, (c) home_sections migration runs (leadership_team in, secondary_banner out). Backend: 54/54 pytest passing (24 Phase T regression + 30 new Phase U) against the live preview URL. Frontend: home-leadership section renders title 'Leadership Team' with both banner data-testids (leadership-2024-2026 + leadership-2026-2028), side-by-side on desktop 1440x900 (b1.x=120, b2.x=736), stacked on mobile 390x800 (b1.y=-896, b2.y=-44). Old 'Setting the standard, every chapter, every day' banner text is GONE from /. Leadership section precedes family-pulse in DOM (indices 3 < 4). Admin → Pages → Site copy shows the new 'Leadership Team banners' toggle (data-testid=home-section-leadership_team) — the secondary_banner toggle is GONE. End-to-end toggle: turning leadership_team OFF + Save → home-leadership not rendered; turning ON + Save → home-leadership restored. All confirmed in live browser.
action_items: Re-verify iteration 19's KNOWN UI bug (Admin → Pages → New page → Save flow not producing retrievable /page/<slug>) — this was NOT re-tested in iteration 20 since it's tracked separately and Phase T still passes the backend-only equivalent. If still broken, fix PageDialog Save handler + add data-testid='page-save-btn'.
Continue server.py refactor — 6626 lines is still huge. Next candidates: /api/events, /api/members, /api/auth route modules.
Add Literal[...PAGE_BLOCK_TYPES] to PageBlockIn so Pydantic enforces block-type at the schema layer (currently enforced only by route handler raises in pages.py and site_settings.py).
critical_code_review_comments: routes/site_settings.py make_default_settings() correctly drops secondary_banner from the default home_sections dict AND the migration block in _ensure_site_settings() pops it from any pre-existing doc. Migration is idempotent.
routes/pages.py is small (66 lines), clean, and uses a register(api, **deps) factory — good pattern for the rest of the refactor.

routes/ai.py register() only depends on require_admin which is sufficient. EMERGENT_LLM_KEY usage is correct (os.environ[...] raises if missing). No real LLM call was made by tests — only admin-gating verified (401/403 for unauth+member). The 200/502 path needs E1 to verify manually with a valid key.

routes/site_settings.py update_site_settings DOES enforce PAGE_BLOCK_TYPES on home_blocks_top/bottom now (line 100-101). This fixes the minor issue reported in iteration 19. test_admin_invalid_block_in_home_blocks_top_400 confirms 400 is returned.
Home.jsx LEADERSHIP array uses term as React key (good) AND maps `data-testid={`leadership-${l.term}`}` which gives stable selectors 'leadership-2024-2026' and 'leadership-2026-2028' as spec'd.
Old secondary_banner block has been fully removed from Home.jsx — only a comment placeholder remains ('Secondary banner photo removed per user request'). Clean cut.
SiteSettingsAdmin.jsx HOME_SECTION_KEYS now correctly has 'leadership_team' instead of 'secondary_banner'. Verified in browser the toggle renders with the expected data-testid.
